values.note: Reserve on Campspot or by calling the park host (231-655-1581). Daily stays are paid in full at booking; 'During holiday weekends, Bear Lake Days weekend and in the month of July, a minimum of 3 night stay is preferred due to demand' (preferred, not stated as a rule). Monthly and seasonal lots are also sold. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://villageofbearlakemi.gov/hopkins-park ('Reserve now by calling (231) 655-1581 or online via CampSpot'), read 2026-10-22

note: Village of Bear Lake campground directly on Bear Lake, with a boat launch, a fishing pier and a swimming beach; sites on the lakefront and behind it. The bath house dates from about the 1920s-40s and has two steps at the entrance. --Claude
summary: Village page confirms 31 back-in sites (lakefront and back lot), daily $45 lakefront / $35 back lot (matches the Campspot-read fees; also monthly $900/$800 and seasonal $2,500/$2,200), reservation season April 20 - October 20, Campspot or phone, showers, dump, WiFi. Water is a communal fill faucet only (hookups.water false). July/holiday 3-night minimum is only 'preferred'. Phone matches.
